# Manual Testing Index

ClearPath Payroll tester materials are for local demo/testing only. Do not use real payroll data, real SSNs, real bank account numbers, real EINs, live API keys, real ACH, or real tax filings.

## Printable Packet

- [Manual Test Packet](MANUAL-TEST-PACKET.md)
- [Print Stylesheet](MANUAL-TEST-PACKET-PRINT.css)
- [Tester Feedback Form](TESTER-FEEDBACK-FORM.md)
- [Tester Issue Log](TESTER-ISSUE-LOG.md)
- [Bug Report Template](BUG-REPORT-TEMPLATE.md)
- [Feature Feedback Template](FEATURE-FEEDBACK-TEMPLATE.md)

## How To Use

1. Open `MANUAL-TEST-PACKET.md`.
2. Print from your markdown viewer or browser.
3. Use the checkboxes during manual testing.
4. Write notes under each section.
5. Complete the tester feedback table at the end.

## Suggested Print Settings

- Paper: Letter
- Orientation: Portrait
- Margins: Default or narrow
- Background graphics: Off

The print stylesheet is optional. It adds page breaks before major sections and simple table borders for paper review.
